body: Silver Fox 606 LLC, the developer of a data center project in Indiantown, Florida, has filed a complaint and verified petition for a writ of prohibition against the Village of Indiantown, its village council and its planning, zoning and appeals board, CBS12 reported on October 12, 2026. The suit, which also names local residents, alleges that village officials are illegally derailing the $25 million project. According to CBS12, Silver Fox bought the more than 600-acre property at 13820 SW Silver Fox Lane in 2025 after zoning verifications confirmed that computer and data processing facilities were an as-of-right use in the Heavy Industrial district.

The suit alleges that after the 2026 municipal elections, the newly seated council tried to stall or ban data center development despite the village's earlier efforts to recruit such projects. CBS12, describing the suit, said the village manager and the longtime village attorney were ousted at a September 1 meeting. WQCS reported that at that meeting the council voted 4-1 to hold off on a proposed moratorium until an interim village attorney gave a legal opinion and voted 3-2 to fire the village manager, and that the village attorney had resigned on August 18. Silver Fox alleges the council violated Florida's Sunshine Law in making the personnel changes.

According to CBS12, the village's community and economic development director administratively approved the Silver Fox plat on September 17, and a resident then filed an administrative appeal seeking to overturn the approvals. Silver Fox argues the appeals board lacks jurisdiction because state law makes a recorded plat unassailable without the landowner's consent. It seeks emergency injunctive relief, a preliminary injunction against any stop-work orders or retroactive reviews, and declarations affirming its vested development rights.

CBS12 reported on October 23 that a Martin County circuit judge had issued an injunction earlier in the month blocking a planned zoning appeals hearing while the case proceeds. At an October 22 meeting, the council scheduled a first reading of a temporary data center moratorium that would exclude Project Silver Fox and two other sites, and council members called for lawsuits over the developments to be dropped as the village seeks to negotiate with developers. No response from the village to the suit's allegations has been reported.

timeline.label: Village council holds off on a proposed data center moratorium and fires the village manager
Village director administratively approves the Silver Fox plat, according to CBS12
Silver Fox files its complaint and verified petition for a writ of prohibition; CBS12 reports the suit on October 12
Martin County circuit judge enjoins a planned zoning appeals hearing while the case proceeds
Village council schedules a moratorium ordinance that would exclude Project Silver Fox
